def max_independent_set(adj, n):
    best = []
    
    def backtrack(available, current):
        nonlocal best
        if len(current) + len(available) <= len(best):
            return
        if not available:
            if len(current) > len(best):
                best = current[:]
            return
        
        # Choose vertex with maximum degree in available (branching heuristic)
        v = max(available, key=lambda x: len(adj[x] & available))
        
        # Branch 1: include v
        new_available = available - {v} - (adj[v] & available)
        backtrack(new_available, current + [v])
        
        # Branch 2: exclude v
        backtrack(available - {v}, current)
    
    backtrack(set(range(n)), [])
    return best

def max_clique(adj, n):
    best = []
    
    def backtrack(candidates, current):
        nonlocal best
        if len(current) + len(candidates) <= len(best):
            return
        if not candidates:
            if len(current) > len(best):

        v = max(candidates, key=lambda x: len(adj[x] & candidates))

        # Branch: exclude v
        backtrack(candidates - {v}, current)
    
    backtrack(set(range(n)), [])
    return best
